The stated goal is 100% line-item coverage at T+0 so the financial close becomes a confirmation rather than a month-end scramble, with an immutable audit trail for GoBD, IFRS, SOX, and BEPS. The company serves logistics, payment service providers, retail and e-commerce, manufacturing, human resources, and construction, is EU-hosted in Frankfurt, and is founded by Barbaros Ozbugutu and Volkan Ozkan and backed by Speedinvest. As a solution-and-services provider it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or docs.

providers.name: Taxfix
providers.description: Taxfix is a Berlin-based fintech that lets individuals and self-employed people in Germany prepare and file their annual income tax return from a mobile app or web browser. Users either answer a guided set of roughly 70 questions to self-file (Taxfix Basic) or hand the return to an independent tax expert via the Expert Service, with data transmitted to the tax authority over the official ELSTER interface. The company reports more than 10 million tax returns filed and over 5 billion euros in refunds. Taxfix is a consumer (B2C) product and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture. Backed by Creandum, Index Ventures and Speedinvest.

providers.name: Reiner.ai
providers.description: Reiner.ai (operated by AI Mapping GmbH of Cologne, Germany) is a construction- and planning-industry AI platform for architects, engineers, and planners. It combines leading LLMs with domain-specific "Reiner Knowledge" and "Reiner Logic" layers to deliver Reiner Chat, task-specific KI-Agenten (AI agents) for site protocols, explanatory reports and project applications, company-knowledge integration, and a library of 50+ prebuilt construction prompts. The product is delivered as a hosted web application (app.reiner.ai); as of this enrichment pass there is no public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Auxmoney
providers.description: Auxmoney (auxmoney GmbH) is a Düsseldorf-based German fintech operating one of Europe's largest online lending marketplaces, connecting consumer and small-business borrowers with private and institutional investors. Its fully digital platform handles personal-loan applications end to end — identity and credit checks, risk scoring, approval within seconds, and disbursement typically within 24 hours — funded by retail investors and institutional capital via its investment arm. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures. auxmoney publishes no public developer API or portal; its integration surface is a partner/affiliate program plus internal open-source tooling on GitHub. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: LAP Coffee
providers.description: LAP Coffee (Life Among People) is a Berlin-founded specialty coffee retail chain operated by Micro Retail Technologies MRT GmbH. It opened its first store in Berlin Mitte in August 2023 and has grown to a network of neighbourhood cafes across Berlin, with further locations and openings in Cologne, Frankfurt, Munich and Hamburg. LAP serves locally roasted specialty coffee at everyday prices from small, high-throughput stores, and runs a consumer mobile app (LAP: Everyday Coffee) for pre-ordering, in-store pickup, a stamps and rewards loyalty program, gifting and referrals, replacing an earlier Apple/Google Wallet stamp pass. LAP is backed by HV Capital. As of this enrichment pass LAP publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or developer documentation; its technology surface is the consumer app, the order.lap.coffee deep-link service and a Webflow marketing site.

providers.name: Enter
providers.description: Enter is a Berlin-based residential energy-efficiency company that positions itself as Germany's largest energy advisor, combining on-site building analysis with installation of heat pumps, photovoltaic (solar) systems, battery storage, EV wallboxes, and home energy-management systems. It guides homeowners through energy consulting, subsidy (Foerderung) applications, and financing, and reports 37,000+ completed projects and 150M+ EUR in secured subsidies. Enter is a B2C service provider with no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs; it was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment.

providers.name: Lilium
providers.description: Lilium was a German eVTOL aircraft developer building the Lilium Jet, a seven-seat (including pilot) ducted-fan electric jet designed for regional air mobility with target cruise speeds around 175 mph and ranges in excess of 100 nautical miles. Lilium pursued concurrent EASA and FAA Type Certification and signed pre-orders with operators across Europe, the Middle East, the United States, Brazil, and Saudi Arabia. In October 2024 Lilium's board approved self-administration for its German subsidiaries after failing to secure a guarantee for a EUR 50 million Bavarian government loan, and in December 2024 the company ceased operations and laid off approximately 1,000 employees. A consortium called Mobile Uplift Corporation GmbH announced a partial asset acquisition in late December 2024, but in February 2025 Lilium's German entities filed a second insolvency after the promised takeover financing failed to materialize. As of this profile (May 2026) Lilium remains non-operational and the website and social channels may be intermittently available; this profile is preserved for historical and archival reference.

providers.name: ecoplanet
providers.description: ecoplanet provides cloud-based, integrated energy management software for German mid-market companies. The platform combines three core functions: real-time consumption monitoring through meter integration with AI-powered anomaly detection and automated load-shifting on price signals; strategic energy procurement using algorithmic purchasing across spot markets, tranches, and power purchase agreements (PPAs); and automated ISO 50001 compliance documentation. The company reports customers achieve up to 15% consumption savings and ~13.9% average price advantages on energy purchases. Backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital. No public developer/API surface was found at the time of profiling.

providers.name: Enpal
providers.description: Enpal is a Berlin-based residential clean-energy company and one of Germany's market leaders in home solar. It sells and finances complete home energy systems — rooftop solar PV, battery storage, air-to-water heat pumps, EV wallbox chargers, and a dynamic electricity tariff — orchestrated by its Enpal.One+ smart energy-management platform, with flexible purchase and zero-down financing options. Enpal serves over 130,000 German households and operates business (business.enpal.de) and installer partner (enpal.pro) channels alongside its consumer offering. Backed by HV Capital and the SoftBank Vision Fund. This API Evangelist profile was created from a VC-portfolio lead; Enpal publishes a consumer website and customer portal but no public developer API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Medwing
providers.description: MEDWING is Germany's largest digital service platform for jobs and staffing in the healthcare sector, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Berlin. It operates a recruitment marketplace that matches hospitals, clinics and care facilities with nurses, caregivers, doctors, midwives, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals across Germany and the United Kingdom. Beyond permanent placement, MEDWING combines career brokerage with temporary-staffing (Zeitarbeit) operations and HR/workforce tooling, offering an end-to-end digital workflow that spans job search, matching, contracts, digital signatures and timesheets. The service is free for candidates, with employers paying on successful placement. MEDWING is backed by Northzone and other investors. This profile was enriched from public web sources; MEDWING does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: MPIRIQ
providers.description: MPIRIQ (MPiriQ Science Technologies GmbH) is a Munich-based healthcare software company that automates clinical documentation for medical practices and study centers. Its AI platform structures patient data directly inside existing EMR/PMS systems, runs quality and billing validation checks in the background, and connects real-world care data to clinical research through decentralized, GDPR-compliant pseudonymization. The platform helps practices participate in clinical trials via automated indication screening and patient recruitment, giving physicians time back while opening a research revenue stream. Founded in 2024 and backed by HV Capital and Speedinvest.

providers.name: Exporo
providers.description: Exporo is a Hamburg, Germany-based digital investment platform for real estate and renewable-energy infrastructure, operating as a regulated European Crowdfunding Service Provider (ECSP). The platform lets private investors participate in residential and commercial property development as well as clean-energy projects such as solar, with typical terms of 12-36 months. Exporo has mediated over EUR 1.17 billion of capital across more than 600 financed projects, and also offers Club Deals for larger qualified investors. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API or developer portal is currently published; this profile is maintained as a company lead and will be enriched if a developer surface appears.

providers.name: Agile Robots
providers.description: Agile Robots SE is a Munich-based robotics and artificial intelligence company founded in 2018 as a spin-off from the German Aerospace Center (DLR) Institute of Robotics and Mechatronics. The company develops force-sensitive industrial and service robots, robotic arms (Diana series), grippers and hands (Agile Hand), mobile robotics, and the AgileCore / AgileAI software platform that lets system integrators and operators build and deploy AI-driven automation for the automotive, consumer electronics, healthcare, and service industries. Headquartered in Munich's Sendling district with manufacturing across Europe, China, and India, Agile Robots reached unicorn valuation in a 2021 Series C and is backed by investors including Hongshan (Sequoia Capital China). This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Agile Robots does not currently publish a public developer portal, REST API, or first-party SDKs.

providers.name: Joblocal
providers.description: Joblocal GmbH is a Munich-based German recruiting technology company and a part of the Funke Mediengruppe. With more than fifteen years of experience it operates a network of 41 regional job portals across Germany and, together with the Funke network, runs data-driven, hyper-regional recruiting campaigns tailored to position, location and budget for over 1,000 client companies. Its "Talent.KI" product applies artificial intelligence to candidate sourcing and regional labor-market analysis, surfacing employers where job seekers actually search. Joblocal was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer portal, API, or machine-readable API artifacts at this time.

providers.name: Lanch
providers.description: LANCH GmbH is a Berlin-based food-tech startup that builds creator-led virtual restaurant brands for the delivery market. Founded by Nono Konopka and Jonas Meynert and headquartered at Schoenhauser Allee 180 in Berlin, LANCH develops food brands together with German influencers, musicians and athletes, then scales them through franchise partners and ghost-kitchen partners operating out of existing restaurant kitchens. Its two flagship brands are Loco Chicken (halal-certified wings, filets, burgers and chicken-and-waffle creations) and Happy Slice (hand-pulled pinsa-dough pizza, dips and cookies), both distributed through delivery marketplaces including Wolt, Lieferando and Uber Eats. The company is backed by HV Capital and Felix Capital alongside founders of FlixBus, Gorillas, Flaschenpost, Glovo, Foodspring, Foodora, Honest Food and Finleap. LANCH publishes a marketing and partner-recruitment website only; as of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API specification or SDK surface.

providers.name: Balance Re
providers.description: Balance Re is a fully licensed German life reinsurance company headquartered in Cologne, with an office in London, offering asset-liability management (ALM) reinsurance solutions to life insurers and pension funds. Its proprietary technology delivers real-time analytics that help clients manage capital and liquidity, price and transfer longevity, savings and retirement risk, and improve competitiveness through quantitative asset-liability management. Balance Re raised a $10M Series A in 2021 led by Anthemis Group, with participation from Global Brain, Roland Berger Industries and Talabot Finance. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; the company publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API, documentation, or machine-readable specifications as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Green Fusion
providers.description: Green Fusion GmbH is a Berlin-based climate-energy software company that provides an intelligent 360-degree energy management platform for the residential real estate sector (Wohnungswirtschaft). Its software digitizes and optimizes building heating systems: "Der Energiespar-Pilot" delivers digital boiler-room management and optimized operation of conventional heat sources (gas, oil, district heating, CHP/BHKW), while its AI platform for sector coupling (Sektorkopplung) integrates heat pumps, PV systems, storage, and grid connectivity for intelligent monitoring and control. The platform is TUV-certified under GEG section 71a. Green Fusion is backed by HV Capital and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a climate-energy provider; it operates a customer control platform (control.green-fusion.de) but publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: rabot.energy
providers.description: rabot.energy (RABOT Energy DE GmbH) is a Hamburg-based German electricity supplier offering dynamic and fixed-rate power tariffs where consumers pay hourly rates that track the wholesale electricity market. The company provides 100% renewable energy certified by TÜV NORD, smart meter installation and management, EV charging optimization (Autostrom), and home battery storage (Rabot Flow), all managed through a consumer mobile app for consumption monitoring. It is a consumer-facing energy retailer; no public developer portal or API is currently published. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of HV Capital.

providers.name: Wellster
providers.description: Wellster Healthtech Group is a German digital healthcare company founded in Munich in 2018 by Dr. Manuel Nothelfer and Nico Hribernik. It operates a digital health ecosystem that integrates a diverse range of direct-to-patient medical brands across Europe, combining synchronous and asynchronous telemedicine with value-based, evidence-driven care. Wellster emphasizes German-based medical supervision, data stored on German servers, and treatments aligned with established clinical standards, acting as a structured filter and patient-routing layer for the healthcare system. It is backed by HV Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. Wellster does not publish a public API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Check24
providers.description: CHECK24 is Germany's largest online comparison portal (Vergleichsportal), founded in 1999 and headquartered in Munich. It lets more than 20 million customers compare prices and switch providers across over 50 categories, including car, life and health insurance, loans and bank accounts, electricity and gas, DSL and mobile tariffs, travel, rental cars, and online shopping. CHECK24 runs its own comparison calculators and a licensed bank (CHECK24 Bank), and integrates partner providers such as Allianz Direct through API-based connections. Backed by Accel, it is profiled in the API Evangelist network as a consumer company. CHECK24 maintains a verified GitHub organization and a GenDev developer scholarship program but publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: QPLIX
providers.description: QPLIX GmbH is a Munich-based wealth management software company offering QPLIX-Q, an all-in-one SaaS platform for professional investors, family offices, asset managers, and banks to consolidate, manage, and report on multi-asset-class portfolios. The platform automates portfolio management, trading and rebalancing, accounting, tax, and client reporting, integrating direct data feeds from 150+ custodian banks (UBS, Julius Baer, Deutsche Bank, and others) and leading market-data providers (LSEG, Moody's, S&P Dow Jones Indices, ISS ESG). QPLIX runs a self-hosted, API-based infrastructure on ISO 27001-certified European data centers, holds an ISAE 3402 attestation, and is registered with Germany's BaFin as an account information service provider (AISP). The company does not publish a public developer API or portal; integrations are delivered as managed add-ons and there is no OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: conrizon
providers.description: conrizon AG is a German holding company, founded in 2020 and headquartered in Essen, that unites four of Europe's leading Enterprise Content Management (ECM) brands - easy software, PROXESS, HABEL, and Portal Systems (Shareflex), alongside the friendWorks professional-services unit - under one roof. The group provides legally compliant, audit-proof digital archiving (GDPR, GoBD, eIDAS), document management (DMS), invoice and procure-to-pay (P2P) processing, contract management, and HR/HCM software with automated workflows, plus AI services and connectors for SAP and Microsoft 365 / SharePoint. Solutions are offered cloud-native, in a private cloud, on-premises, or hybrid, and are relied on by more than 8,700 companies and organizations worldwide. conrizon is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. It publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Cylib
providers.description: Cylib is a German battery recycling company founded in 2022 as a spinoff from RWTH Aachen University, headquartered in Aachen, Germany. It transforms end-of-life lithium-ion batteries, production scrap, and black mass back into critical raw materials, recovering lithium, graphite, nickel, cobalt, and manganese through a proprietary, largely water-based hydrometallurgical process that the company reports achieves over 90% recycling efficiency with an ~80% reduced carbon footprint versus primary extraction, powered by 100% renewable electricity. The company is backed by Speedinvest and other investors. Cylib operates as an industrial cleantech / circular-economy materials business and does not currently publish a developer program, public API, developer portal, SDKs, or other software integration surface; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and carries only identity and public web properties.

providers.name: digitaleseiten
providers.description: Digitale Seiten is a German online marketing company that operates a network of 28+ industry-specific business directories for craftspeople and local service providers (for example Elektriker.org, Klempner.org, Maler.org and Dachdecker.org). The platform lets tradespeople create free business listings, distributes regional customer inquiries and job requests to registered companies as leads, improves their search-engine visibility, and provides review-collection tools. According to the company it lists 869,000+ registered businesses and has matched 765,000+ job assignments. It is a B2B directory and lead-generation service and does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or developer portal. Backed by Point Nine.

providers.name: Fidor Bank
providers.description: Fidor Bank was a German digital challenger bank founded in Munich in 2009 and an early pioneer of Banking-as-a-Service and open banking through its fidorOS / bankOS middleware platform and public REST API, which covered Customers, Accounts, Transfers, Transactions and Account Information over an OAuth2 authorization-code flow. Fidor was acquired by France's Groupe BPCE in 2016; following years of post-acquisition integration struggles the bank ceased business operations in mid-2023 and entered liquidation. Its developer portal (fidor.com) is now a parked domain and the sandbox and production API hosts are offline. The surviving first-party developer artifacts are the archived official Ruby client (RubyGems: fidor_api, by Fidor Solutions AG) and the github.com/fidor organization. This is a retired provider retained for historical reference.

providers.name: Momox
providers.description: momox SE (formerly Momox AG / Momox GmbH) is a Berlin-based re-commerce company founded by Christian Wegner in 2004 — the name stands for "Moderner Medien Online Express-Ankauf" (Modern Media Online Express Purchase). Through momox.de it buys used books, CDs, DVDs/Blu-rays and games from private sellers at fixed prices in Germany, Austria, France, Belgium and the UK, reselling them via its Medimops shop and third-party marketplaces. Its momox fashion arm (formerly ubup.com, momoxfashion.com) does the same for second-hand clothing, shoes and accessories. momox runs large logistics centres in Berlin, Leipzig and Neuenhagen bei Berlin and has handled more than 350 million articles since founding. momox is a consumer-facing re-commerce operation; it publishes no official public developer program, API portal, or SDKs. The only machine surface is an internal, undocumented mobile-app pricing endpoint (api.momox.de / api.momox.fr) that is not offered as a first-party API.

providers.name: Raus
providers.description: Raus (operated by StayRaus GmbH, Berlin) is a consumer platform for booking sustainable, design-forward tiny cabins in nature across Germany and Austria, giving city dwellers a quick escape "close to home." Guests browse and book fully-equipped smart cabins in forests, by lakes, and on farms, add culinary experiences and extras, buy gift cards, and can list their own land as a host. Raus was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a B2C hospitality/booking brand with a public consumer website but no publicly documented API, developer portal, SDKs, or developer documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: The Exploration Company
providers.description: The Exploration Company (TEC) is a European deep-tech space startup founded in July 2021 by Hélène Huby and a team of aerospace engineers from Airbus and ArianeGroup. Headquartered in Munich, Germany with sites in Bordeaux, Oberpfaffenhofen, Italy, France, Houston, and the MENA region, TEC develops Nyx, a family of modular, reusable, in-orbit refuelable spacecraft designed to carry cargo — and eventually humans — to low Earth orbit, lunar orbit, and the Moon, serving space stations and long-distance research missions. The company has raised a €40.5M Series A and a €150M Series B and is a certified B Corp. It exposes no public developer API; interfaces are provided to payload customers via a Payload User's Guide.

providers.name: Volocopter
providers.description: Volocopter is a German urban air mobility company developing electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft for passenger and cargo use. Its product portfolio includes VoloCity, a two-seat multicopter air taxi pursued under EASA SC-VTOL certification; VoloRegion, a longer-range fixed-wing transition design for inter-city flights; VoloDrone, a heavy-lift cargo drone; and VoloIQ, a digital operations platform built on Microsoft Azure for fleet, route, and vertiport management. Volocopter has demonstrated flights in numerous cities including Paris, Singapore, Seoul, and Dubai, and worked toward operations around the Paris 2024 Olympics. The company experienced significant financial restructuring in 2024-2025 and ownership changes affecting commercial timelines; current status should be verified against the latest newsroom updates.

providers.name: Felmo
providers.description: felmo (felmo GmbH) is a mobile veterinary practice (mobile Tierarztpraxis) headquartered in Berlin, Germany that brings licensed veterinarians directly to pet owners' homes for dogs and cats. Founded in 2019 by CEO Philip Trockels, felmo operates across Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf and 25+ additional German cities, and has treated 300,000+ animals with 8,000+ home visits per month via 140+ mobile vets. Services include preventive care and consultations, examinations and diagnostics, laboratory and imaging, surgical procedures (including a fully-equipped mobile operating vehicle / OP-Wagen), dental medicine and holistic pet care, billed per the German veterinary fee schedule (GOT). Customers book appointments, access medical records and lab results, receive reminders, and message support through the felmo iOS and Android app. felmo is backed by HV Capital and additional venture investors. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public identity and web properties.

providers.name: i2x
providers.description: i2x is a German real-time AI platform for contact centers, built by i2x GmbH in Mönchengladbach. It provides live agent assistance that surfaces contextual recommendations during calls in under 0.4 seconds, including automatic detection of purchase signals and faster agent onboarding; full-coverage call analysis with automatic transcription plus quality, compliance, and sales-opportunity scoring across 100% of conversations; and voicebots for automated inbound/outbound telephony and virtual agent-training scenarios. The platform emphasizes DSGVO/GDPR compliance with EU-only hosting in German data centers, prepared works-council documentation, and EU AI Act alignment, positioning itself as an alternative to US-cloud-dependent conversation-intelligence tools. No public API, developer portal, or SDKs are currently published; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of hv-capital.

providers.name: KUKA
providers.description: KUKA AG is a German industrial automation company headquartered in Augsburg, Bavaria, founded in 1898 and majority-owned by China's Midea Group since 2016. KUKA designs and manufactures industrial robots, autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), production cells, controllers, and the software stack that drives them. Its product portfolio spans six-axis articulated robots (KR series), sensitive collaborative robots (LBR iiwa, LBR iisy), mobile platforms (KMR iiwa, KMP), and palletizing/welding/CNC cells, controlled by the KR C4 and KR C5 / KR C5 micro controller generations. The robot software stack centers on KUKA System Software (KSS/VSS) for KR C4-class hardware, the newer iiQKA.OS / iiQKA.OS2 operating system for KR C5, and the KUKA Robot Language (KRL) for motion programming, with extension surfaces including KUKA.RobotSensorInterface (RSI), KUKA.EthernetKRL, KUKA.PLC mxAutomation for external PLC control, KUKA.OPC UA, and KUKA.AppTech / iiQKA App Builder for option packages. Engineering and simulation are delivered through iiQWorks (iiQWorks.Sim, iiQWorks.App Builder, iiQWorks.Copilot) and KUKA.Sim, while operational software includes KUKA Xpert (documentation/cloud), KUKA iiQoT (condition monitoring), and KUKA Connect / my.KUKA customer portals. KUKA does not publish a first-party public REST/OpenAPI developer API or an official GitHub organization for its robot control stack; integration is performed through proprietary protocols (RSI, EthernetKRL, mxAutomation, OPC UA, PROFINET, EtherCAT) and SDKs distributed via the iiQKA Creator portal and KUKA Xpert. A meaningful body of open-source KUKA integration code lives in the community-maintained kroshu GitHub organization (ROS 2 drivers, external-control SDK, URDF robot descriptions) and the roboticsapi / openkuka projects. KUKA serves automotive, electronics, battery, metal, consumer goods, healthcare, aerospace, and e-commerce logistics customers, and through its Swisslog subsidiary extends into warehouse and intralogistics automation.

providers.name: Scondoo
providers.description: Scondoo is a German consumer cashback and coupon platform, operated by acardo group AG, that lets shoppers earn money back on everyday grocery and drugstore purchases. Users browse exclusive cashback deals in the scondoo iOS and Android apps, buy the qualifying products at any supermarket or drugstore (Kaufland, REWE, EDEKA, Netto, Aldi, Lidl, dm, Rossmann and many more), then snap a photo of the receipt to have the cashback credited to their balance and paid out via bank transfer or PayPal. The service is consumer-facing and mobile-only; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or partner integration surface.

providers.name: Schüttflix
providers.description: Schüttflix is a Gütersloh, Germany based digital logistics platform for the construction industry, describing itself as the first digital logistics hub to connect construction companies, building-material suppliers, disposal companies and carriers. The marketplace digitizes the full workflow from ordering bulk materials (sand, gravel, crushed stone) through transport dispatch to the delivery note, and adds construction-waste disposal and circular-economy recycling services. Schüttflix operates as a neutral marketplace ("we don't compete, we connect") spanning 4,000+ suppliers and disposers, 6,800+ partner carriers and 33,000+ vehicles, delivered primarily through native iOS and Android apps rather than a public API. It is a portfolio company of HV Capital, added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: ExpressSteuer (fka Express Group)
providers.description: ExpressSteuer (formerly Express Group) is a German tax-technology company, originally a Hamburg-based fintech backed by Insight Partners that offered an app-based, largely automated income-tax-return (Steuererklärung) service aimed at consumers and employees. The expresssteuer.de domain currently presents a German-language tax-information and guidance website (built on WordPress) covering income tax, self-employment, and everyday financial topics. No public developer program, API, SDK, or /.well-known/ discovery surface is published. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead for enrichment.

providers.name: feld.energy
providers.description: feld.energy (Feld.Energy GmbH) is a Freising, Germany based Agri-PV (agrivoltaics) project developer and investment company that helps farmers and landowners install turnkey agricultural photovoltaic systems on their fields. It combines expertise from agriculture, energy, and project development to co-locate crop or livestock production with solar generation, offering landowners lease income, revenue sharing, or full-ownership models with state-secured grid feed-in over roughly 20 years. The company handles every step from land assessment and permitting through construction and operation. It reports 800+ partner farmers, 900+ hectares of projects, and 320+ MW of secured grid capacity. It is a portfolio company of HV Capital and is in the API Evangelist network as a climate-energy company profile; it publishes no public developer API, portal, SDK, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Craftview
providers.description: Craftview Software GmbH is a Frankfurt-headquartered European software group that builds ERP and project-management software for the skilled trades. Formed as a buy-and-build platform, Craftview operates a portfolio of long-established regional ERP brands — C'FLUIDE, ES2000, EXTRABAT, GILDE, KS21, MOSER, OSD, PLENION, RITA BOSSE and WINWORKER — serving green industries, construction-related trades, technical services and specialized crafts across Germany, Belgium, the Netherlands and France. The group reports 25,000+ active customers, 330+ employees and 11 locations across 41 key European regions. Craftview publishes no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable API definitions; its software is sold and delivered per brand as on-premise and cloud ERP for trade businesses.

providers.name: Kenbi
providers.description: Kenbi is a German healthcare organization focused on nursing education and workforce development, operating through two divisions. Kenbi Academy delivers continuing professional development for care workers with 100+ ZFU-certified courses recognized by all German health insurers and available nationwide, spanning nursing service management, quality assurance, wound care, and instructor training. Kenbi Campus runs vocational nursing programs in Berlin and Hamburg, including a three-year registered nurse generalist program and an 18-month nursing assistant curriculum. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public developer program, API, or documentation surface was found.

providers.name: INURU
providers.description: INURU (Inuru GmbH) is a Berlin-based printed-electronics company that manufactures ultra-thin, flexible printed OLED lighting for smart packaging, labels, apparel, and medical products. Its core product, the Elf (Embeddable Luminous Film), combines an inkjet-printed OLED, a power source, and a microchip into a paper-thin, waterproof film that can glow in any shape and respond to touch, motion, or sound. Founded in 2016, Inuru operates the automated "Dragon Factory" OLED production line in Wildau and works with brands such as Coca-Cola and Marvel on interactive, sustainable smart-packaging and medication-adherence labels. This is a company/provider record in the API Evangelist network; Inuru is a hardware and smart-packaging manufacturer and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Audi Connect / myAudi
providers.description: Audi Connect is the connected-vehicle services platform from Audi AG, the Ingolstadt, Germany-based luxury automaker and member of the Volkswagen Group. Delivered to drivers through the embedded MMI infotainment system and the myAudi companion app for iOS and Android, Audi Connect spans remote vehicle control (lock/unlock, remote start, climate pre-conditioning, EV charge management), safety and security (Emergency Call/eCall, Audi Service Request, stolen-vehicle locator, geofencing, speed alerts), and in-car infotainment (real-time traffic, satellite map imagery, parking and fuel information, weather, news, natural voice recognition, Amazon Alexa, Amazon Music, Wi-Fi hotspot, and an in-vehicle app store with Disney+ and passenger gaming on supported models). Services are packaged as Audi connect CARE (included for ten years on new U.S. Audis), Audi connect NAV (navigation and live traffic), and Audi connect PLUS (premium streaming and Wi-Fi). For EVs and PHEVs, Audi Connect adds charging-station search, remote charge monitoring, and cabin pre-conditioning. Audi does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, OAuth program, or partner SDK for myAudi/Audi Connect; programmatic access today is brokered by third-party connected-car aggregators (Smartcar, High Mobility, Enode, Mojio) under Audi's commercial agreements, and community projects reverse-engineer the mobile-app endpoints. Audi has publicly discussed an internal OpenAPI-driven API management strategy (with Nagarro) but the surface remains private to Audi, VW Group brands, and authorized partners.

providers.name: Doctorly
providers.description: Doctorly (doctorly GmbH, Berlin) builds a modern cloud-based practice management system (Praxisverwaltungssystem / PVS) for medical practices in Germany, positioned as a replacement for legacy systems such as Medistar, Turbomed and ALBIS. The platform covers KV quarterly billing, e-prescription (eRezept), electronic sick leave (eAU), real-time collaborative patient records, GDT device integration and cross-platform access on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android, and it is KBV-, gematik- and GDPR-compliant. Doctorly is a Seedcamp portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/FHIR specification, SDKs or GitHub organization; this entry is maintained as a company/provider record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: PraxiPal
providers.description: PraxiPal GmbH (Berlin, Germany) builds Luna, an AI voice receptionist for medical, dental, therapeutic, and veterinary practices. Luna answers incoming phone calls 24/7, handles patient questions, books and reschedules appointments, and processes prescription requests autonomously, integrating directly with 40+ German practice-management systems (PVS) such as CGM MEDISTAR, tomedo, charly by solutio, DAMPSOFT, and DENSoffice. It operates in a GDPR-compliant manner on European servers with medical-confidentiality safeguards under German law. PraxiPal is backed by HV Capital. No public API, developer portal, or SDK is currently published; this profile tracks the company as an API Evangelist network lead.

providers.name: DailyDeal.de
providers.description: DailyDeal.de is a German consumer deals, coupons, and discounts platform ("Deals, Gutscheine & Schnäppchen") that aggregates daily deals across categories including electronics, fashion, home and garden, beauty, kids, sports, and free-to-try product samples ("gratis testen"). Shoppers browse discounted products, brand vouchers, and shop-specific coupon codes, and read shopping guides in the site's Magazin. Originally founded in Berlin in 2009 and briefly owned by Google, DailyDeal today operates as a WordPress-based consumer commerce and content site and publishes no public developer API program. It was added to the API Evangelist network as an Insight Partners portfolio lead.

providers.name: Eleqtron
providers.description: eleQtron GmbH is a German quantum computing hardware company founded in 2020 as a spin-off from the Quantum Optics Department at the University of Siegen by Prof. Dr. Christof Wunderlich, Dr. Michael Johanning (CTO), and Jan Leisse (CEO). Based in Siegen, Germany, eleQtron develops freely programmable, scalable trapped-ion quantum computers built on its proprietary MAGIC (Magnetic Gradient Induced Coupling) technology, which controls qubits with microwaves rather than lasers for higher precision and a clearer path to scaling. The company aims to become a leading provider of quantum computing time for industrial applications across chemicals, pharmaceuticals, automotive, logistics, finance, and machine learning. eleQtron's systems are made accessible to developers through cloud platforms and standard quantum frameworks (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane) rather than a first-party public REST API. Backed by Earlybird Venture Capital.

providers.name: Encentive
providers.description: encentive GmbH is a German industrial energy-technology company founded in 2020 and headquartered in Neumuenster. Its AI-driven smart energy management platform, flexOn, automatically optimizes and controls electricity consumption for industrial and commercial operations, orchestrating assets such as PV/solar systems, battery storage, heat pumps, cooling and thermal storage, CHP, wind, and EV charging infrastructure alongside existing energy management systems. flexOn combines plant data, weather forecasts, and real-time market prices to shift loads to periods when energy is cheapest and greenest, cutting energy costs by up to 20% and CO2 emissions by up to 30%. It integrates with industrial assets over REST API, SFTP, OPC UA, and Modbus TCP. encentive publishes no public developer API, portal, or specification; integration is delivered as part of its managed platform, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: hallo theo
providers.description: Hallo theo (rebranding to "Theo") is a German residential property management company (Hausverwaltung) that manages homeowners' associations (WEG/HOA), rental apartment buildings, and commercial properties across Germany. With 150+ experts and local teams in Berlin, Frankfurt am Main, Munich, Stuttgart, and Wildeshausen, the company manages over 20,000 units and is Section 26a HOA-certified, combining on-the-ground regional teams with central specialists in law, technology, and finance. Backed by Insight Partners, it offers HOA management, property management, commercial property management, succession, and sale-and-stay-on services to co-owners and building owners. This is a services company with a marketing/lead website (built on Framer + HubSpot); it publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Serviceware SE
providers.description: Serviceware SE is a German enterprise software, consulting, and managed-services company with more than 25 years in business, roughly 420 employees, and over EUR 100 million in annual revenue. Its platform spans Enterprise Service Management (ESM) for IT, HR, and customer service, IT Financial Management (ITFM) for cost tracking and technology business management, Corporate Performance Management (CPM) for budgeting, planning, and reporting, AI-powered Knowledge Management, and Field Service Management. Serviceware positions its platform as AI-native, with no-code workflows, data integration, governance, and self-service capabilities. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: wefox
providers.description: wefox is a Berlin-headquartered digital insurance distribution platform that connects insurance carriers, brokers, and end customers through a single technology stack. Founded in 2014 and originally known as FinanceFox, the company operates across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, and France, selling personal-lines products such as motor, home, liability, life, and commercial insurance via its in-house carrier (wefox Insurance) and a network of independent brokers. wefox positions itself as an "indirect" insurtech — meaning it distributes through human advisors augmented by software rather than selling direct-to-consumer — and has historically been one of Europe's most highly funded insurtech companies, with backing from Mubadala, Target Global, Salesforce Ventures, OMERS Ventures, Eurazeo, Mountain Partners, and others. The platform itself is a multi-tenant SaaS used by brokers and agents to manage customer relationships, quote and bind policies across multiple carriers, handle claims, and trigger commissions. wefox does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or a github.com/wefox organization; integration with the wefox platform is carrier-, broker-, and partner-mediated rather than self-service, and there is no Tier-1 developer surface to document. This repo profiles wefox as an insurance distribution business and tracks any future move toward a public API program.

providers.name: Schuettflix
providers.description: Schuettflix is a German digital logistics platform for the construction industry, founded in 2018 in Guetersloh. It operates a neutral B2B marketplace that connects construction companies, bulk-material suppliers, freight forwarders and waste-disposal firms in a single fully digital workflow. Through its iOS and Android apps, customers order sand, gravel and crushed stone with transparent real-time pricing, coordinate dispatch and transport, capture delivery documentation, manage routes, and handle mineral-waste disposal and circular-economy recycling of construction materials. The company digitizes the traditionally analog and fragmented process of procuring and delivering bulk goods, earning a commission on the transactions facilitated through its platform. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest. No public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Hades
providers.description: Hades Mining GmbH is a Munich-based deep-tech extraction company building technology-first methods for accessing critical minerals and geothermal energy from ultra-deep rock formations. Its flagship system, Cerberus, uses high-power continuous-wave fiber lasers delivered through proprietary fiber optics to fracture rock without mechanical bit wear, paired with in-situ recovery (ISR) fluid circulation to extract minerals without open-pit excavation. The company positions itself at the intersection of geology, engineering, and geopolitics under the tagline "Sovereignty begins subsurface," aiming to reduce Western dependence on imported critical minerals. Hades is backed by HV Capital and Headline via a EUR 15M seed round. As a physical deep-tech extraction company, Hades publishes no public developer API, SDK, or MCP surface at this time.

providers.name: Warehousing1
providers.description: Warehousing1 is a Berlin-based LogTech company, founded in 2018 by Nico Szeli, Nils Aschmann and Fabian Sedlmayr, that operates a digital fulfillment and warehousing marketplace connecting brands and e-commerce merchants to an independent network of more than 1,000 logistics locations across Germany, Europe and the US. Its cloud platform and customer portal centralize warehousing, order picking, packing and shipping, and integrate with common ERP systems, online shops and marketplaces so companies can scale contract logistics, distribution and e-commerce fulfillment. The company has served 500+ customers and is backed by HV Capital, Schenker Ventures, Aster Capital and Wille Finance. Warehousing1 does not publish a public developer API; integration is delivered through managed ERP/shop connectors and its customer portal.

providers.name: sento
providers.description: sento is a Munich-based B2B software company (sento GmbH) building a cloud-based EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) platform that automates complex business-partner processes, letting companies replace slow, manual partner-integration workflows with automated document and data exchange. Founded by Nimar Blume and Felix Krauth and backed by Insight Partners, sento raised a EUR 9 million seed round to expand its partner-onboarding and document-automation product. As of this profile sento does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation - only its corporate marketing site and legal pages are publicly available.

providers.name: Rizm
providers.description: RIZM is a holistic energy optimization platform for industrial enterprises, operated by Kerith GmbH of Münster, Germany. It integrates data from production, energy procurement, and infrastructure into a digital twin, then optimizes energy system design and day-to-day operational decisions — from long-term infrastructure investment and power purchase agreements to short-term asset dispatch and production scheduling — helping manufacturers cut energy costs and emissions at the same time. Named customers include BMW Group, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, and BSH. The product is delivered as a login-gated web application (app.rizm.de) with authenticated documentation; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published at this time. Backed by Point Nine, this profile was surfaced from the venture portfolio graph.

providers.name: Powerus
providers.description: PowerUs is Germany's largest job platform for skilled trades and crafts, connecting tradespeople (electricians, plumbers, roofers, metalworkers, mechanics and more) with employers across construction, electrical and mechanical industries. The platform offers automated job matching based on location, salary and working conditions, one-click applications without cover letters, direct employer-to-worker discovery, and native iOS and Android apps. PowerUs reports 250,000+ registered skilled workers and 6,000+ open positions. It is a consumer/employer marketplace product and does not currently expose a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI-described API surface; its api.powerus.de and docs.powerus.de hosts are private/internal (docs gated behind Cloudflare Access). Backed by General Catalyst and HV Capital.

providers.name: Buena
providers.description: Buena (Buena GmbH) is a Berlin-based modern property management company serving real estate owners across Germany, managing over 70,000 units. It provides WEG (condominium / Wohnungseigentümergemeinschaft) management, rental property management (Mietverwaltung), and property-management succession (Nachfolge) for owners seeking an alternative to conventional, reactive administrators. Buena positions itself as a technology-forward, proactive Hausverwaltung. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of EQT Ventures and GV and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Buena publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical documentation — this profile captures verified company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: dehaze
providers.description: dehaze is a Munich-area (Fürstenfeldbruck, Germany) healthtech company, part of the Techstars Berlin cohort, building proprietary causal AI infrastructure that detects chronic and autoimmune disease earlier by identifying overlooked diagnoses, health risks, and inappropriate treatments. Its platform unifies and harmonizes diverse health data (lab results, medical imaging, genomics, clinical notes) into doctor-validated patient journeys, risk-profiles individuals against millions of health journeys and medical guidelines, and runs targeted AI follow-ups to improve treatment adherence for patients, payers, and providers. dehaze has analyzed over 250,000 patient lives across 300 million health events and 200+ AI algorithms, and raised €3.2M in 2026. dehaze publishes no first-party developer API; it exposes a Wix Site MCP endpoint and an llms.txt for agentic AI access to public site content.

providers.name: Alphora Holdings
providers.description: Alphora (Alphora GmbH / Alphora Holdings) is a Berlin-based, AI-native managed IT services company founded in 2025 and backed by Northzone at the seed stage. Its agentic platform runs IT operations end-to-end for businesses and managed service providers (MSPs) — an integrated IT service desk, managed compliance and documentation, managed AI delivered by forward-deployed engineers, endpoint cybersecurity, user and hardware provisioning, and 24/7 network and cloud monitoring — pairing centralized intelligence with local execution across a shared data lake. The company operates alphora-it.com with a marketing site and active careers portal but does not yet expose a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: CatalYm
providers.description: CatalYm GmbH is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Planegg-Martinsried near Munich, Germany, developing next-generation cancer immunotherapies. Its lead approach neutralizes GDF-15 (Growth Differentiation Factor 15) to reverse a key immune-resistance mechanism in solid tumors, aiming to reinstate anti-tumor immune activity and overcome resistance to checkpoint-inhibitor and other cancer therapies. The company is a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. This is a biotech/pharmaceutical organization with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Kiwilogic
providers.description: Kiwilogic.com AG was a German conversational-AI pioneer founded in 1999 in Hamburg, with a secondary office in London. It built the Lingubot platform, one of the earliest commercial natural-language dialogue engines for the web, which let online businesses deploy interactive virtual characters that acted as store greeter, customer-support agent, product specialist and entertainer across web sites and mobile messaging channels. The company was backed by Earlybird Venture Capital (approximately $5.2M reported) and won a best-German-startup award in 2000. The Lingubot business was acquired in the mid-2000s and folded into Artificial Solutions, whose Teneo conversational-AI and voice-AI platform is the commercial successor; the kiwilogic.com domain now issues a blanket redirect to teneo.ai. Kiwilogic operates no independent developer portal, documentation, or API surface today, and this profile is maintained as a historical company record within the API Evangelist network rather than as an active API provider.

providers.name: Klima
providers.description: Klima was a Berlin-based consumer climate-action company operated by Climate Labs GmbH, founded in 2019 by Markus Gilles, Jonas Brandau and Andreas Pursian-Ehrlich. Its mobile app let individuals calculate a personal carbon footprint from a lifestyle questionnaire, then offset those emissions through a subscription funding Gold Standard and Verified Carbon Standard projects, with in-app education and reduction tips layered on top. The company raised roughly USD 16.7M across a 2020 seed round and a EUR 10M 2022 Series A, backed by HV Capital, Keen Venture Partners, Headline, 468 Capital and Adjacent. Klima was acquired by Wren on April 30, 2025; klima.com is now a single-page wind-down notice and the company exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable artifacts.

providers.name: Purpose Green
providers.description: Purpose Green is a Berlin-based sustainability consulting firm and 360-degree provider for sustainable real estate development, serving property owners and investors who manage multi-unit residential and commercial buildings. The company combines energy auditing (its Energy Light Report tool), ESG reporting, subsidy and grant consultation, renovation project management, and a web-based portfolio management portal (Green+ Portal) to help reduce a building's final energy demand by up to 80%. It is backed by Speedinvest and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; the company publishes web tools and a customer portal but no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Heartbeat Medical
providers.description: Heartbeat Medical is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of hv-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Home24
providers.description: Home24 is a leading pure-play home & living e-commerce retailer in Continental Europe, founded in Berlin in 2009. It operates across Germany, France, Austria, the Netherlands, Switzerland, Belgium and Italy, selling furniture and home accessories through home24.de and its sister storefronts with a catalog of more than 250,000 products, alongside its own private labels and logistics network. Since April 2023 Home24 SE has been part of the Austrian XXXLutz Group, and it was delisted from the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in September 2023. Home24 publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI definition; its programmatic surfaces are a partner/affiliate marketing program and marketplace seller integrations used to syndicate product-data feeds, plus a public engineering blog. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the API-artifact facets are not applicable because there is no public API surface to harvest.

providers.name: mcmakler
providers.description: McMakler is a German hybrid residential real-estate brokerage (proptech) headquartered in Berlin, combining local human agents with in-house technology to list, market, and sell homes across Germany, Austria, and France. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-20 probed the public surface and found no public developer API, developer portal, documentation, or well-known discovery catalog; an internal backend host (api.mcmakler.de) exists but returns 403 and is not a published API. Domain transport/email security was probed and recorded.

providers.name: Finiata
providers.description: Finiata was a Berlin-founded fintech providing working-capital and invoice financing to small businesses, freelancers and micro-enterprises, operating principally in Germany and Poland and backed by investors including Point Nine. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of point-nine and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment. As of the 2026-07-20 enrichment pass Finiata has no live public surface: finiata.com is registered but fully undelegated (no NS, SOA, A, MX or TXT records) and does not resolve; the former developer portal developer.finiata.com, archived as live in 2019, no longer resolves; and finiata.de has been taken over by unrelated third-party gambling-affiliate content. The only live first-party assets found are the company's GitHub organization (github.com/debitech) and one unmaintained internal npm tooling package. No API, OpenAPI or other machine-readable specification, documentation, or well-known surface exists to catalog.

providers.name: Kwest
providers.description: Kwest was a Berlin-based B2B SaaS platform for the operations behind renewable-energy installations. Founded by Robin Dechant, Marco Holst and Constantin Ehren, it gave solar, heat-pump and smart-meter installers a workflow platform covering project management, inspection documentation, automated report creation and incident management, plus integrations that synced installation data with the CRM, ERP and field-service tools those companies already ran (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Dynamics 365, Odoo, Xentral, weclapp, Zoho, Aurora Solar, Solytic, Praxedo, Zapier and others). Speedinvest invested in 2021. In 2024 Kwest was acquired by Kraken Technologies, the technology arm of Octopus Energy Group, which folded the Kwest workflow platform into the Kraken stack and opened its first development hub in Berlin around the seven-person team. Kwest published no public API or developer program, and the company no longer operates independently - its former getkwest.com domain has lapsed and now serves unrelated third-party content, so it is recorded here as historical only and is not linked as a live website.

providers.name: Planqc
providers.description: planqc GmbH is a German quantum computing company building neutral-atom quantum computers, using individual atoms trapped in optical lattices as qubits on what it describes as the most promising path to fault-tolerant, scalable systems. Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of the Max Planck Institute of Quantum Optics and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich, the company delivers full-stack quantum computing — hardware, control software, and applications — including its MAQCS (Multicore Atomic Quantum Computing System) line for enterprise and scientific customers across aerospace, automotive, energy, and financial services. planqc operates from Garching and Ulm in Germany and Innsbruck in Austria, and is backed by investors including Speedinvest. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or programmatic cloud-access surface; access is arranged directly through the company. This profile is a portfolio-lead stub in the API Evangelist network, enriched with verified public identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Smava
providers.description: Smava (smava GmbH) is a Berlin-based German consumer-finance marketplace, founded in 2007, that lets borrowers compare personal, auto, and mortgage loan offers from more than 20 partner banks for amounts ranging from EUR 1,000 to EUR 120,000, without impacting their SCHUFA credit score. The company operates a digital, data-driven loan-brokerage platform serving consumers across Germany and employs roughly 600 people. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Earlybird. As of this enrichment pass Smava is a consumer (B2C) web and mobile-app business and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or well-known API discovery endpoints.

providers.name: avimedical
providers.description: Avi Medical is a technology-enabled primary care provider headquartered in Munich, Germany, operating a network of modern general-practice (Hausarzt) medical practices paired with a patient-facing mobile app for booking appointments, video consultations, prescriptions, and digital access to medical records. The company combines physical clinics with digital health tooling to modernize German primary care, and is backed by Balderton Capital among other investors. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company; no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal has been found on its public surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Purmeo
providers.description: PURMEO GmbH is a German ("Made in Germany") manufacturer and direct-to-consumer retailer of high-quality nutritional supplements, vitamins, and minerals, with a focus on digestive health (including H. pylori support), energy, immunity, cognitive function, vision, bone and joint support, and cardiovascular health. Products are formulated without artificial additives, GMOs, or magnesium stearate and are distributed via the company's own online shop as well as Amazon, DocMorris, Medpex, and Shop-Apotheke. Surfaced as a portfolio company of point-nine and added to the API Evangelist network. As of the enrichment pass this is a B2C e-commerce business with no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Savedo
providers.description: Savedo was a German fintech operating a consumer deposit marketplace that let savers in Germany open fixed-term and savings accounts across multiple European partner banks from a single portal. Backed by Point Nine, it was acquired by Deposit Solutions in 2017 and is now a subsidiary brand of Raisin SE (WeltSparen). The Savedo customer portal was deactivated on 31 March 2022 and the brand no longer accepts new customers; existing balances are administered via flatexDEGIRO Bank AG. Savedo published no public API, developer portal, or SDKs. This profile is retained as a network lead surfaced from the Point Nine portfolio.

providers.name: Thalamed
providers.description: Thalamed is a Berlin-based medical device procurement marketplace, founded in 2014, that connects healthcare providers such as clinics, private practices, and outpatient care facilities with suppliers of medical equipment including ultrasound and x-ray devices, sterilization and disinfection systems, and medical lasers. Customers describe the device they need and Thalamed's team evaluates the request and contacts the most suitable providers to deliver matching quotes, simplifying comparison and purchasing. The company is a Point Nine and RTAventures portfolio company. No public developer API, documentation, or integration surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: 6 Wunderkinder
providers.description: 6 Wunderkinder (6Wunderkinder GmbH) was a Berlin-based software startup founded in 2010 that built Wunderlist, a popular cross-platform to-do list and task management application. The company shipped a public REST API for Wunderlist in 2013, along with webhooks and integrations such as Slack and Sunrise, and rebuilt its backend into roughly 60 microservices behind a single unified API. Backed by Earlybird and Sequoia Capital, 6 Wunderkinder was acquired by Microsoft in June 2015 for a reported US$100-200M. Microsoft folded the product into Microsoft To Do and discontinued Wunderlist on 6 May 2020. This profile is retained as a historical record; the company is defunct and publishes no live API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: asgoodasnew
providers.description: asgoodasnew is a German e-commerce retailer of refurbished and pre-owned consumer electronics, including smartphones, tablets, laptops, cameras, and related accessories, sold with warranty through its online store at asgoodasnew.de (asgoodasnew.com redirects there). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. Probing the public surface found no developer portal, API documentation, or API host — this is a consumer-facing storefront with no public API program at this time. The profile is retained as a portfolio lead; only mechanical domain-security signals for the web host could be captured.

providers.name: Chemtura
providers.description: Chemtura Corporation was a global specialty chemicals company that developed, manufactured, and marketed chemical intermediates, additives, specialty chemicals, urethanes, organometallics, and modern plastics. In April 2017, Chemtura was acquired by LANXESS AG, the German specialty chemicals company headquartered in Cologne, and its operations were integrated into LANXESS's Performance Materials and other business segments. Chemtura products are now marketed and supported through LANXESS, which continues to serve agriculture, animal care, mobility, consumer goods, electrical and electronics, energy, food, and healthcare end markets.

providers.name: Conjectag
providers.description: Conjectag (Conject AG / Conject Holding GmbH) was a Munich-based German construction technology company founded in 2000 that provided cloud-based software for the built environment, covering project management, collaboration, document control, and construction cost management for the AEC (architecture, engineering, and construction) sector. It was surfaced as a historical Earlybird Venture Capital portfolio company. Conject was acquired by the Australian construction collaboration platform Aconex in March 2016, and Aconex was subsequently acquired by Oracle in December 2017; the company no longer operates independently and publishes no live website or developer/API surface. This profile is retained for network provenance rather than active enrichment.

providers.name: DaWanda.com
providers.description: DaWanda.com was a German online marketplace for handmade, unique, and custom-made products, founded in 2006 in Berlin. It connected independent makers and small designers with buyers across Germany and Europe, comparable to Etsy in the DACH region. DaWanda ceased operations on 30 August 2018 and partnered with Etsy to migrate its sellers and buyers; the www.dawanda.com domain now redirects to Etsy Germany. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. No public developer program or API surface was found during enrichment; the company is defunct and retained here as a historical/portfolio record.

providers.name: DCS-Touristik (DCS Travel)
providers.description: DCS-Touristik GmbH, trading as DCS Travel (dcs.travel), is a German river- and sea-cruise operator based in Nagel, Germany. The company organizes river cruises on major European waterways — primarily the Danube and the Rhine — as well as sea cruises along the Croatian coast, operating its own vessels including the DCS Amethyst 1 and DCS Amethyst 2. Its business is direct consumer travel booking: multi-day cruise packages (roughly 3 to 12 days), organized transfers and shore excursions, themed sailings, travel-insurance partnerships, and early-booking discounts. This is a consumer-facing tourism brand with no public developer program, API, SDK, or developer documentation. It was originally added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio stub; that classification appears to be a false match (the "early-bird" cruise discount wording rather than the Earlybird venture firm), and no API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Dooyoo De
providers.description: Dooyoo was a German consumer product-review and price-comparison platform built on user-generated reviews, best known for its "dooyooMiles" rewards program that paid users for writing reviews. It was acquired by the French shopping-guide publisher LeGuide.com in 2008, and the LeGuide group (Ciao, Dooyoo, and others) was in turn acquired by Kelkoo in 2016 to form Kelkoo Group. The dooyoo.de domain no longer operates as an independent brand and now 301-redirects to kelkoogroup.com; there is no active developer portal, public API, or documentation surface. This profile is retained as a defunct/absorbed portfolio lead with no API artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: Honest Food Company
providers.description: Honest Food Company GmbH is a Berlin-based cloud-kitchen / ghost-restaurant operator founded in 2017 that produced and delivered food under a portfolio of virtual delivery-only brands (Mamacita, Blattgold, Baba Noni, Beste Freunde, Holy Chicken, Clubkitchen) ordered through its own sites and third-party delivery platforms. Backed by Creandum and Index Ventures, it was acquired by Delivery Hero SE in February 2020 and folded into the Delivery Hero group; it operates no independent public developer/API surface. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Creandum portfolio lead. Sector: consumer / food delivery.

providers.name: Hundeland
providers.description: Hundeland was a German direct-to-consumer online shop for dog supplies — dog food, treats, accessories, and pet-care products — and a portfolio company of the Point Nine venture capital firm. The hundeland.de storefront has been permanently closed ("dauerhaft geschlossen") and now 302-redirects to Pets Premium (petspremium.de), operated by the same company, which carries the same brands and product range; former customers must re-register there. Hundeland publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs, so the enrichment pipeline found no API surface to harvest. This record is retained as a Point Nine portfolio lead with the real closure status captured; the only machine-verifiable artifact is the domain-security probe of the still-resolving hundeland.de host that serves the redirect.

providers.name: Institut für Produktqualität
providers.description: Institut für Produktqualität (ifp) is an independent analytical testing laboratory based in Berlin, Germany, providing laboratory analysis, testing, and consulting services for food, feed, cosmetics, and pharmaceutical products. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the provider publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or machine-readable discovery surface; its public website is served behind bot-protection (HTTP 401) and exposes no /.well-known documents. This profile therefore carries identity and domain-security signal only.

providers.name: Milano Vice
providers.description: Milano Vice is a Berlin-based virtual restaurant company founded in 2021 by Rudolf Donauer and Dennis Murselovic (both ex-Delivery Hero) that operates a digitally-powered, delivery-first pizza brand. It partners with professional kitchens across German cities including Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg and Frankfurt to prepare and deliver handmade pizzas and pinsa to homes and offices, orderable through its own website and third-party delivery platforms such as Lieferando, Wolt and Uber Eats. It is a consumer food brand backed by Speedinvest, Coefficient Capital, True and Geschwister Oetker, and does not currently publish a public developer API surface. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub.

providers.name: Tipp24
providers.description: Tipp24 is a German consumer online-lottery brand — a business-to-consumer service where players place bets on the outcomes of state and international lottery draws (secondary lottery / lottery brokerage) over the web and mobile apps. The brand is operated by ZEAL Network SE, a publicly listed company headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, whose email infrastructure (SPF/DMARC) still resolves to zealnetwork.de. Tipp24 is a regulated consumer gambling product; it exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs, and its web properties (tipp24.de, tipp24.com) sit behind Cloudflare bot protection. This profile originated as an Earlybird VC portfolio lead and was processed by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline, which confirmed the absence of an API surface and captured the domain security posture of the brand.

providers.name: Zeitgold
providers.description: Zeitgold was a Berlin-based fintech that automated bookkeeping, invoice and receipt processing, payments, and financial administration for small and medium-sized businesses, blending software with human back-office review. It was backed by Battery Ventures and other investors and was acquired by Deel in 2021. As of this enrichment pass the company operates no independent public developer surface: zeitgold.com does not respond on HTTP or HTTPS, and zeitgold.de resolves to a parked/reserved domain page. No public API, developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or other machine-readable artifact could be discovered, so this profile remains an identity-only record.

providers.name: element 5 AG
providers.description: element 5 AG was a German e-commerce and digital-distribution company founded in 2000 and headquartered in Cologne, Germany. It operated a platform that let software developers and publishers sell their products and licenses directly to customers online, growing to more than 10,000 clients across 150 countries and becoming one of Europe's leading software e-commerce providers. element 5 was acquired by U.S.-based Digital River (its direct competitor) for roughly $120M and subsequently absorbed and renamed Digital River GmbH, ceasing to operate as an independent company. It was an early Earlybird Venture Capital portfolio company; this profile records its identity and exit. No live independent API or developer surface remains to enrich.

providers.name: Roclub
providers.description: roclub (roclub GmbH) is a German health-tech company operating a remote-control platform for diagnostic medical imaging. Its software lets healthcare organizations perform MRI and CT examinations remotely ("Remote Scanning") and support on-site technicians from anywhere ("Remote Support"), with real-time screen sharing and device control across multi-vendor scanners (Siemens, Philips, GE, Canon). roclub also runs a marketplace of qualified medical technologists ("rocStars") who can be booked on demand, together with session documentation, scheduling, and built-in liability insurance ("roCover"). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation was found during enrichment.

bands.label: Not Yet Rated
bands.blurb: Providers we have not scored yet — unknown, not zero.

providers.name: AEB
providers.description: AEB SE is a German supply chain and global trade software company, headquartered in Stuttgart and 100% employee-owned, whose platform is used by 7,300+ companies for customs filing, trade compliance, multi-carrier shipping, transport and freight cost management, and warehouse management. In the logistics chain AEB sits at the intermediation layer of customs and trade tech: it is the certified filer between the shipper or forwarder and the customs authority (German ATLAS, EU AES/NCTS/ICS, EMCS, Intrastat, UK CHIEF), and the multi-carrier abstraction between the shipper and 300+ carriers, generating the carrier EDI so the customer never has to. Its API posture is unusually open for this tier: four public ReadMe developer hubs (Customs, Trade Compliance, Transport & Freight Management, SAP add-ons) publish machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.1 for every product, served live and unauthenticated from AEB's own test and demo instances, with shared try-it credentials in the docs. But the contract is entirely proprietary — a REST-over-RPC business-facade shape unique to AEB, with a legacy SOAP business facade still exposed beside it — and production access requires registering with AEB and licensing the products, so it is a documented, quotable, contract-gated API rather than a self-serve one.

providers.name: DB Schenker
providers.description: DB Schenker (Schenker AG, headquartered in Essen, Germany) is one of the world's largest freight forwarders and contract logistics providers, moving air, ocean, land and rail freight and running warehousing for shippers across roughly 1,850 locations. As a forwarder it sits in the intermediation layer of the supply chain — between the shipper who owns the cargo and the carriers, terminals and customs authorities who move and clear it — buying capacity it does not own and reselling visibility it did not have to publish. Its API posture is honestly a customer-contract posture, not a public developer posture. Deutsche Bahn sold DB Schenker to DSV A/S, completing 30 April 2025, and as of this profile www.dbschenker.com 301-redirects to dsv.com while the global developer portal at api-portal.dbschenker.com answers HTTP 410 Gone. The one DB Schenker-branded machine-readable API surface still live is the Nordic parcel "Partner services API" at parcelservices-se.dbschenker.com/Apipartner, which publishes four Swagger 2.0 documents openly but returns 401 on every operation without HTTP Basic credentials issued against a signed Swedish transport agreement. Its EDI endpoints are proprietary JSON, not EDIFACT or X12, and no DCSA, IATA ONE Record, GS1 EPCIS or WCO Data Model conformant contract was found on any reachable host.

providers.name: HV Capital
providers.description: HV Capital is one of Europe's leading early-stage and growth venture capital firms, headquartered in Munich with an office in Berlin. Founded in 2000 as Holtzbrinck Ventures (the venture arm associated with Verlagsgruppe Georg von Holtzbrinck), the partnership completed a management buyout and rebranded to HV Capital in 2018, establishing full operational and investment independence. The firm backs European founders with global ambitions across the full lifecycle: its Venture fund writes seed and Series A checks from roughly €500K to €10M, while its Growth fund invests through Series B and beyond with checks up to €60M and follow-on reserves reaching €100M per company. HV invests across consumer internet, enterprise software and SaaS, fintech, deep tech, healthcare, climate and energy, cybersecurity, and AI. The firm reports more than €2.8B in assets under management across nine fund generations spanning Venture and Growth, over 290 portfolio companies, and 12 IPOs. Its investment philosophy — "too new is our baseline, too bold is our reason, too complex is our edge" — reflects a willingness to back complex, category-defining companies. Early and notable investments include Zalando, Delivery Hero, FlixBus, SumUp, Depop, Scalable Capital, Enpal, and Isar Aerospace. This profile tracks HV Capital's identity and its portfolio graph across the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Lufthansa Cargo
providers.description: Lufthansa Cargo AG is the air freight arm of the Lufthansa Group, headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany. It sells and operates belly capacity across the Lufthansa passenger fleet plus its own Boeing 777F freighters, and runs the Frankfurt Cargo Center hub, so it sits in the chain as the airline carrier between the freight forwarder and the destination handling agent. Its API posture is real but two-speed: a live Apigee developer portal at developer.lufthansa-cargo.com publishes four OpenAPI 3.0 contracts anonymously downloadable without a login (Routing Offer, Shipment Tracking, Shipment Tracking Subscribe, Station Information), while six further API products in the same portfolio - smartBooking, Truck PreAdvice, ULD Status, AirMail, CargoXML and CargoIMP - are published only as info-block stubs carrying the sentence that access is granted upon prior approval and agreement. Registration is reviewed by Lufthansa Cargo API managers before keys are issued and production access requires successful test-environment validation, so this is application-approval, not self-serve. The published REST surface is a proprietary Lufthansa Cargo shape, but it carries open air-cargo vocabulary inside it - IATA AWB prefix 020 plus 8-digit AWB numbers, 3-letter IATA station codes and the IATA cargo status code set (RCS, MAN, DEP, ARR, RCF, NFD, DLV) - while the legacy Cargo-IMP and Cargo-XML EDI message sets remain in the portfolio as gated products and IATA ONE Record went live in July 2026 through the IBS Software ONE Record server rather than as anything Lufthansa Cargo publishes itself.

providers.name: Point Nine Capital
providers.description: Point Nine Capital is a thesis-driven, early-stage venture capital firm founded in 2011 and headquartered in Berlin, Germany. It is one of Europe's best-known seed investors, specializing in B2B SaaS, B2B marketplaces, developer tools and infrastructure, fintech, digital health, and increasingly AI across digital, physical, and biological domains. Point Nine typically writes initial checks of roughly $1M-$10M (EUR 0.5M-5M) and aims to be the first institutional investor for "v0.9" founders graduating from friends-and-family capital. The firm runs a deliberately small, equal partnership in which each partner works closely with only 6-8 companies at a time to provide deep operational support. Since inception it has backed more than 160 startups across 30+ countries, including early bets on Algolia, Chainalysis, Clio, Contentful, Delivery Hero, Docplanner, Factorial, Front, Loom, Mambu, NexHealth, Revolut, Typeform, Zendesk, and Westwing, with 11+ companies reaching unicorn status.
